title: Dignity Scenario Cards
purpose: Practice treating every person as someone with God-given dignity.
body_markdown:
# Dignity Scenario Cards

Read one scenario. Ask: “What would it look like to treat this person as valuable?”

1. A new child does not know the game.
2. Someone speaks more slowly than you.
3. A child is left out at lunch.
4. Two children want the same toy.
5. Someone made a mistake and feels embarrassed.
6. A person looks, moves, or communicates differently from you.

## Guardrail

Do not ask children to identify a classmate who fits a scenario. Keep examples general.
